checks.lead: Georges Biassou (French pronunciation: [ʒɔʁʒ bjasu]; 1 January 1741 – 14 July 1801) was an early leader of the 1791 slave rising in Saint-Domingue that began the Haitian Revolution. With Jean-François and Jeannot, he was prophesied by the vodou priest Dutty Boukman to lead the revolution.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
